pattern_summary: Four dominant error patterns drive the 68.4% alignment rate: (1) Maude fails to extract strain_reported in 92.5% of cases, treating cultivar names, receptor agonist identifiers, and pure compound names as null rather than as strain/compound identifiers; (2) cannabis_type is mis-classified in 85% of cases, with Maude defaulting to 'unknown', 'concentrates', or 'vape pen' instead of correctly identifying 'pure cannabinoid', 'CB receptor agonist', 'CB receptor antagonist', or 'dried flower'; (3) administration_frequency and duration_days are nearly always null in Maude (67.5% and 60% disagreement) because temporal dosing language in Methods sections is not parsed; (4) thc_mg_kg and cbd_mg_kg are systematically missed (27.8% and 33.3%) because Maude lacks extraction logic for numeric mg/kg dose values from structured Methods text.

proposed_rules_changes.description: Cannabis_type: Replace the 'unknown' default with a multi-signal classifier. Priority order: (1) if compound name is a known synthetic agonist (CP-55940, WIN55212, O-1602, JWH-*, HU-*) → 'CB receptor agonist'; (2) if compound name is a known antagonist (SR141716, AM251, rimonabant) → 'CB receptor antagonist'; (3) if text contains isolated THC/CBD/CBG/CBDV + mg/kg dosing + no plant-matter language → 'pure cannabinoid'; (4) if 'cannabis plant matter' or 'dried flower' or explicit THC% → 'dried flower'; (5) if 'extract' or 'whole plant extract' → 'full spectrum extract'; (6) else → 'unknown'.
proposed_rules_changes.patch_hint: Refactor classify_cannabis_type() in maude_classifier.py; add a synthetic_agonist_compounds list and a pure_cannabinoid_compounds list; check text for these before falling through to 'unknown'.

proposed_rules_changes.description: Strain_reported: Implement a named-entity extraction pass for (a) known cannabis cultivar names, (b) compound identifiers adjacent to 'isolated', 'chemovar', 'cultivar', (c) coded cultivar labels like CN2/CN4/CN6, (d) pharmaceutical-grade compound descriptions including supplier. Return concatenated string rather than null.
proposed_rules_changes.patch_hint: Add extract_strain_reported() function using regex patterns: named compound IDs (e.g. [A-Z]{2,}-?[0-9]+), quoted strain names, cultivar keyword context window (±30 chars around 'cultivar'/'chemovar'/'strain').

proposed_rules_changes.description: Administration_frequency: Add a regex extraction pass over Methods text for patterns: 'once daily', 'twice daily', 'every other day', 'alternating days', 'X times/week', 'N days on / M days off', 'daily from GD X'. Map these to a controlled vocabulary and store as administration_frequency.
proposed_rules_changes.patch_hint: Add extract_administration_frequency() in maude_classifier.py. Use ordered regex list with named groups. Apply to full abstract + Methods excerpt when available.

proposed_rules_changes.description: Duration_days: Add numeric extraction for explicit day-count patterns: 'N days', 'N-day treatment', 'N-day chronic', 'gestational day(s) X-Y' (compute Y-X), 'PND X to PND Y' (compute Y-X), 'X weeks' (multiply by 7). Prefer explicit numeric values over inferred values.
proposed_rules_changes.patch_hint: Add extract_duration_days() function; handle gestational day ranges specially: GD_pattern = r'gestational day[s]?\s*(\d+)[–-](\d+)' → int(m.group(2)) - int(m.group(1)). PND pattern similarly.

proposed_rules_changes.description: thc_mg_kg / cbd_mg_kg: Add targeted regex extraction for mg/kg dose values. Patterns: 'THC\s*\(?([0-9.]+)\s*mg/kg', 'delta-9-THC.*?([0-9.]+)\s*mg/kg', 'CBD\s*\(?([0-9.]+)\s*mg/kg'. Handle µg/kg by converting to mg/kg (divide by 1000). Extract first match; if multiple doses present set multiple_doses=true.
proposed_rules_changes.patch_hint: Add extract_thc_cbd_mg_kg() in maude_classifier.py. Run on abstract + Methods. Handle µg/kg unit conversion. Store in thc_mg_kg / cbd_mg_kg fields.

proposed_rules_changes.description: Inhaled_exposure_duration: When exposure_method includes smoke/vapor, parse 'N-min session', 'N minutes of exposure', 'exposed for N min' patterns and store as inhaled_exposure_duration string.
proposed_rules_changes.patch_hint: Add extract_inhaled_duration() triggered only when inhalation method detected. Regex: r'(\d+)[- ]min(?:ute)?\s*(?:session|exposure|period)'.

proposed_rules_changes.description: Exposure_method / 'edible' mapping: Add 'edible' and 'food treat' and 'mixed in food' as positive cues for oral administration. Remove spurious injection-keyword match when the broader context describes edible/oral delivery.
proposed_rules_changes.patch_hint: In classify_exposure_method(), add edible_cues list; check context window before assigning injection. If 'edible' appears within 50 chars of THC/CBD mention, prefer oral_administration over injection.

proposed_rules_changes.description: Cannabis_type 'vape pen' over-triggering: 'vape pen' should only be assigned when the text explicitly references a consumer vape pen device or cartridge. 'Vapor inhalation' or 'vaporized' alone with plant matter should map to 'dried flower'; with pure compounds should map to 'pure cannabinoid'. Add a device-specificity check before assigning 'vape pen'.
proposed_rules_changes.patch_hint: In classify_cannabis_type(), gate 'vape pen' on presence of 'vape pen', 'vape cartridge', 'e-cigarette cartridge' — not on 'vapor' alone.

proposed_rules_changes.description: cbd_pct extraction: When multiple strains/cultivars are described with different CBD percentages, extract the highest/primary CBD% (or all values) rather than the first numeric match which may be the THC% of a secondary strain. Associate the % with the correct cannabinoid via a paired (compound, value, unit) extraction.
proposed_rules_changes.patch_hint: Refactor extract_cannabinoid_pct() to use paired regex: r'([0-9.]+)%\s*(THC|CBD|cannabidiol|tetrahydrocannabinol)' and r'(THC|CBD).*?([0-9.]+)%'. Resolve ambiguity by compound name proximity.

proposed_cues.explanation: When dosing is expressed as mg/kg alongside a cannabinoid name (THC, CBD, cannabidiol, tetrahydrocannabinol) and no plant-matter language appears, this strongly signals 'pure cannabinoid'.
Pharmaceutical supplier names (Sigma-Aldrich, Cayman Chemical, Tocris) confirm isolated pure cannabinoid, not plant extract.
Phrase 'cannabinoid agonist' or 'CB1 agonist' / 'CB2 agonist' maps to 'CB receptor agonist', not 'unknown'.
Distinguishes dried flower / whole plant vapor from vape pen products; should trigger 'dried flower' classification.
Explicit label 'synthetic cannabinoid' maps to 'CB receptor agonist' category.
Word 'cultivar' or 'chemovar' adjacent to a name string signals a strain name to extract.
'isolated from [strain name]' pattern identifies the source cultivar as strain_reported.
Phrase 'twice daily' should map to administration_frequency = 'twice daily'.
Pattern 'daily from gestational day X-Y' encodes both frequency (daily) and duration (Y-X days).
Compute duration_days = Y - X when gestational day range is stated (e.g., GD 6-20 → 15 days).
Explicit 'N days' or 'N-day treatment' phrases should be parsed directly as duration_days.
'N-min sessions' or 'N minutes' in inhalation context maps to inhaled_exposure_duration.
'edible' or 'food treat' signals oral administration route.
Regex pattern 'THC\s*\(?([0-9.]+)\s*mg/kg' should extract thc_mg_kg numeric value.
Regex pattern 'CBD\s*\(?([0-9.]+)\s*mg/kg' should extract cbd_mg_kg numeric value.

maude_improvement_brief.summary: Node2b batch alignment sits at 68.4% driven by four systemic failures: (1) strain_reported is null in 92.5% of papers because Maude has no named-entity extraction for compound identifiers, cultivar codes, or supplier-qualified compound descriptions; (2) cannabis_type defaults to 'unknown', 'concentrates', or 'vape pen' due to overly broad or absent compound-type classification logic; (3) administration_frequency and duration_days are not extracted from Methods text because no temporal-dosing regex parser exists; and (4) thc_mg_kg/cbd_mg_kg are not parsed from mg/kg dosing strings in abstracts. The fix requires adding five new extraction functions and refactoring the cannabis_type classifier with a priority-ordered compound-type decision tree.
top_gap_patterns: strain_reported null in 92.5% of papers: no extraction of cultivar codes, compound names, or supplier descriptions
cannabis_type mis-labelled in 85% of papers: 'vape pen' and 'unknown' over-fire; 'pure cannabinoid' and 'CB receptor agonist' under-fire
administration_frequency and duration_days null in 67.5% and 60% of papers: no Methods-text temporal regex parser
thc_mg_kg/cbd_mg_kg null in 28-33% of papers: no mg/kg numeric extraction with unit-conversion for µg/kg
inhaled_exposure_duration null in 80% of inhalation papers: no session-duration regex for vapor/smoke studies

### 1. Refactor classify_cannabis_type(text) — HIGH PRIORITY
Replace the current logic with a priority-ordered decision tree:
```python
SYNTHETIC_AGONISTS = ['cp-55940', 'cp55940', 'win55212', 'win 55,212', 'o-1602', 'jwh-', 'hu-210', 'hu210', 'am2201']
SYNTHETIC_ANTAGONISTS = ['sr141716', 'am251', 'am-251', 'rimonabant', 'am630', 'cid16020046']
PURE_CANNABINOIDS = ['delta-9-thc', 'delta9-thc', 'tetrahydrocannabinol', 'cannabidiol', 'cannabigerol', 'cannabidivarin', 'cbdv', 'cbg', 'thcv']
PLANT_MATTER_CUES = ['plant matter', 'dried flower', 'cannabis sativa plant', 'cannabis flower', 'smoked cannabis', 'combusted cannabis']
EXTRACT_CUES = ['whole plant extract', 'full spectrum extract', 'cannabis extract', 'botanical extract']
VAPE_PEN_CUES = ['vape pen', 'vape cartridge', 'e-cigarette cartridge', 'vaping device']
```
Priority: synthetic agonist → antagonist → vape pen (device-specific only) → plant matter → extract → pure cannabinoid (isolated compound + mg/kg) → unknown.

### 2. Add extract_strain_reported(text) — HIGH PRIORITY
Extract:
- Named cultivar strings near 'cultivar', 'chemovar', 'strain', 'variety' (±40 char window)
- Coded cultivar labels: regex r'\b(CN\d+|[A-Z]{2,3}-?\d{2,}|\d{3}-\d{2}[A-Z])\b'
- Compound identifiers qualified by supplier: pattern 'COMPOUND_NAME.*?Sigma-Aldrich|Cayman|Tocris'
- Explicit compound names in isolation context: 'isolated [compound]', 'purified [compound]'
Return semicolon-joined string of all matches, or null if none.

### 3. Add extract_administration_frequency(text) — HIGH PRIORITY
Use ordered regex list:
```python
FREQ_PATTERNS = [
    (r'\btwice\s+daily\b', 'twice daily'),
    (r'\bonce\s+daily\b|\bdaily\b(?!\s+from)', 'daily'),
    (r'\bevery\s+other\s+day\b|\balternating\s+days\b', 'every other day'),
    (r'(\d+)\s*times?\s*/\s*week', lambda m: f"{m.group(1)}x/week"),
    (r'daily\s+(?:for\s+)?5\s+days?.*?2\s+days?\s+off', '5 days on / 2 days off'),
    (r'\bonce\s+weekly\b|\bweekly\b', 'once weekly'),
    (r'\btwice\s+weekly\b|\b2x\s*weekly\b', 'twice weekly'),
]
```
Return first match string or null.

### 4. Add extract_duration_days(text) — HIGH PRIORITY
Handle these patterns in priority order:
```python
# Explicit N-day
r'(\d+)[- ]day\s+(?:treatment|chronic|exposure|study)' → int(match)
# Explicit 'for N days'
r'for\s+(\d+)\s+days?' → int(match)
# Gestational day range
r'gestational\s+day[s]?\s*(\d+)[–\-](\d+)' → int(m2) - int(m1)
# PND range
r'PND\s*(\d+)\s+to\s+PND\s*(\d+)' → int(m2) - int(m1)
# Post-natal day range
r'post-natal\s+day[s]?\s*(\d+)[–\-](\d+)' → int(m2) - int(m1)
# N weeks
r'(\d+)[- ]week\s+(?:treatment|chronic|exposure)' → int(match) * 7
```
Return float or null.

### 5. Add extract_thc_cbd_mg_kg(text) — HIGH PRIORITY
```python
# THC mg/kg
r'(?:THC|tetrahydrocannabinol|delta-?9)[^.]{0,40}?([0-9.]+)\s*mg/kg'
# CBD mg/kg  
r'(?:CBD|cannabidiol)[^.]{0,40}?([0-9.]+)\s*mg/kg'
# µg/kg → divide by 1000
r'(?:THC|cannabinoid\s+agonist)[^.]{0,40}?([0-9.]+)\s*[µu]g/kg'
```
If multiple doses found, set multiple_doses=True and store lowest dose (or list). Return (thc_mg_kg, cbd_mg_kg) floats.

### 6. Add extract_inhaled_duration(text) — MEDIUM PRIORITY
Trigger only when exposure_method contains smoke/vapor:
```python
r'(\d+)[- ]min(?:ute)?\s*(?:session|exposure|inhalation|period)'
r'exposed\s+for\s+(\d+)\s*min'
r'(\d+)\s*minutes?\s+of\s+(?:vapor|smoke|inhalation)'
```
Return string like '30 minutes'.

### 7. Fix exposure_method 'edible' mapping — MEDIUM PRIORITY
Add to oral_cues: ['edible', 'food treat', 'mixed in food', 'in peanut butter', 'gavage'].
Add context check: if 'edible' within 60 chars of cannabinoid name → oral, override injection.

### 8. Fix cannabis_type 'vape pen' over-trigger — HIGH PRIORITY
Only assign 'vape pen' when text contains explicit device terms: 'vape pen', 'vape cartridge', 'e-cigarette cartridge'. Do NOT assign on 'vapor', 'vaporized', 'vapor inhalation' alone.
